boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, university-documented study environments in UMBC’s Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery, spanning quiet work, group collaboration, media creation, and presentation practice.

cards.title: Reservable Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Reserve up to five days ahead for a group session; bring your work plan and use the room’s whiteboards and computers to keep everyone aligned.
cards.short_summary: A bookable group-work option with whiteboards and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists 14 group study rooms for UMBC students, faculty, and staff; they may be reserved up to five days ahead for up to three hours per person or group daily.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Available to UMBC faculty, students, and staff. Reserve up to five days ahead; three-hour daily limit per person or group.

cards.title: Reservable Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Book a focused solo block up to five days ahead, then use the quiet room to separate concentrated reading or writing from busier library areas.
cards.short_summary: Bookable quiet rooms designed for individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists eight reservable individual study rooms for UMBC faculty, students, and staff, with reservations up to five days ahead and a three-hour daily limit per person.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Available to UMBC faculty, students, and staff. Quiet rooms; reserve up to five days ahead for up to three hours daily.

cards.title: Open Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Use the listed room numbers to find an open room when your schedule changes; these first-come spaces suit an impromptu individual work session.
cards.short_summary: Eighteen first-come rooms for unplanned study time.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies 18 open study rooms that students may use on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served for students; consult the library’s listed room numbers.

cards.title: Presentation Practice Room (257)
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery, Room 257
cards.notes: Bring a flash drive and rehearse your talk with the one-button recording system, then review the recording before class, an interview, or a group presentation.
cards.short_summary: A rehearsal room that records presentations for review.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 257 is set up for students to practice presentations and speeches using a one-button recording system; reservations take precedence over walk-up use and the key is available at the Check Out Desk.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Reservations are not required but take precedence over walk-up appointments. Check out the key at the library’s Check Out Desk.

cards.title: Simmons Collaboration Room (368)
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery, Room 368
cards.notes: Reserve this small-group room when a shared screen will help; Chromecast can stream from a laptop, tablet, or phone to the room’s smart TV.
cards.short_summary: A small-group room with a conference table and Chromecast-enabled TV.
cards.evidence_claim: Simmons Collaboration Room 368 is available to UMBC students, faculty, and staff, with a conference table and smart TV with Chromecast; groups of three to seven may reserve it for up to three hours.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Available to UMBC students, faculty, and staff. Reserve for groups of 3–7 for periods up to three hours.

cards.title: Richard Roberts Seminar Room (140)
cards.subtitle: Retriever Learning Center, Room 140
cards.notes: Plan a team session around the projector and large monitor, and reserve a two-hour block when you need a whiteboard-ready room for shared materials.
cards.short_summary: A reservable RLC seminar room with display and projection tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Richard Roberts Seminar Room in the RLC has a conference table, large-screen monitor, projector, laptop cables, and whiteboards; UMBC students, faculty, and staff may reserve it for group periods up to two hours.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Available to UMBC students, faculty, and staff; group reservations are limited to two hours.

cards.title: Digital Media Lab
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Use an editing workstation for media coursework, or book the Whisper Room or Audio/Video Recording Room when a project needs controlled recording space.
cards.short_summary: A media-production workspace with recording rooms and editing software.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Media Lab is open to UMBC students, faculty, and staff and includes computer workspaces with editing software, a Whisper Room, and an Audio/Video Recording Room.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open to UMBC students, faculty, and staff. Book time for the Whisper Room or Audio/Video Recording Room.

cards.title: Retriever Learning Center (RLC)
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Arrange the mobile furniture around your group’s task, then use the movable whiteboards and large monitors to work through problems, drafts, or slides together.
cards.short_summary: A flexible collaboration space with mobile furniture, whiteboards, and monitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The RLC provides mobile furniture, movable whiteboards, large monitors, computers, and individual and group study space; the library designates it as a 24-hour space.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: The library lists the RLC as a 24-hour space; check the library’s current hours page for exceptions.

cards.title: AOK Library Floors 3 and 4
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Choose these whisper-level floors when reading or drafting needs fewer interruptions; library PCs are available if you need to switch from laptop work.
cards.short_summary: Quiet library floors with computers for individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The library designates its third and fourth floors as quiet areas where users should keep volume to a whisper, and reports 22 student-use PCs on these floors.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Quiet areas: keep volume to a whisper. Access follows current library building hours.

cards.title: AOK Library Floors 5 and 6
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Head here for tasks that benefit from silence, such as close reading or exam preparation; use one of the available PCs if a campus workstation is needed.
cards.short_summary: Absolute-quiet library floors with student-use computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The library designates its fifth and sixth floors as absolute quiet areas at all times and reports 32 student-use PCs on those floors.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces, Lockers & Specialty Rooms | Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.access_notes: Absolute quiet at all times. Access follows current library building hours.
